title: Manage Glossary for R Translation Projects
text: repository uses pre-commit. install run , follow steps : external terminal run pip3 install pre-commit --user (Windows) brew install pre-commit (macOS). Based level permissions , either directly clone repository clone fork repository local directory. Install {devtools} {precommit} package. Run precommit::use_precommit() console. precommit installed, time run git commit, precommit hooks run automatically. checks fail, need fix issues can successfully commit changes.
code: git clone https://github.com/r-devel/glossary (or git clone https://github.com/USER_NAME/glossary, if it is your fork of the repo) cd glossary install.packages("devtools") install.packages("precommit")

title: Manage Glossary for R Translation Projects
text: basic example shows solve common problem:
code: library(glossary) current_glossary <- data.frame() updated_glossary <- update_glossary(     glossary = current_glossary,     english = "data frame",     spanish = "marco de datos",     updated_via = "GitHub",     weblate = "include"     )
